questions.question: What is the characteristic polynomial of $\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\0&3\end{pmatrix}$?
questions.explanation: For the triangular $\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\0&3\end{pmatrix}$, the characteristic polynomial is $(t-3)^2$.

$(t-1)(t-3)$ is wrong; both diagonal entries are $3$.
